chat.t: [Lucky Truck] Your package is scheduled to arrive this afternoon.
■ Product Name: (Hidden at customer's request) // 1 Box
Report for work here starting tomorrow.

o: Isn't your attitude a bit too different now?

chat.t: Why should I? You're not a customer anymore.
Whatever, just make sure you eat a hearty breakfast.
Because if we're busy, you might not get to eat lunch.
Yeah, but if we're busy, we can't help it, right?

o: This boss is completely out of her mind.

lines.t: Hideout
One lazy afternoon.
Delivery!
It's here...!
Hello, I'm Charlotte, the courier who contacted you earlier.
Before you receive it, please confirm one thing.
This is your delivery receipt. Please read it carefully and sign.
Huh? You read it already?
Hurry, hurry.
Hmm... Well, whatever.
Alright, valued customer. Confirmation is complete.
Please use Lucky Truck again next time!
Lastly, please click 'Agree' on the tip agreement here.
...A tip? What tip?
The tip for the delivery of the package.
It was written on the receipt you just signed. Didn't you read it carefully?
...Where does it say that?
Here, and here.
Something is written on the tablet in tiny, microscopic letters.
The delivery service fee shall be 50% of the item's value,' this part right here.
It's clearly written.
Do you honestly expect me to see this?
Wait, why is the tip so expensive?!
*Sigh*...
I'm sure I told you to read it carefully.
If you didn't want to pay the tip, you shouldn't have signed.
And I'm not asking for a tip just because I simply dropped off a package.
We don't think of our job as just delivering items.
Wondering when your order will arrive, worrying if it'll get damaged in transit.
We believe our role is to ease those natural anxieties and worries of our customers.
And this kind of service is only possible at <Lucky Truck>.
Even so, pulling off highway robbery like this...
You won't get a single penny out of me.
Whew... you're quite a stubborn customer.
Since you've already signed, I can't give you the package without the tip.
Because our service fee is included in that tip.
But if you absolutely refuse to pay...

...I have no choice.
I'll just have to sell this item to cover the loss.
You can't do that!
That's a limited edition I won't be able to buy again!!

What even is this?
The sender is... 'PLAYCLUB'?
A massage device that makes you feel good.
...Ugh, what kind of massage device has a limited edition?
Anyway, so it's an important item to you.
And because it's so important, you chose a 'slightly' expensive service like ours.
And yet, you still refuse to pay the tip?
Do you take installments?
Hmm...
Then let's do this.
If you do me a favor, I'll return the item.
Here, read it carefully this time and sign.
What is this?
An employment contract.
It's an agreement where you provide labor, and in return, I give this back to you.
I'll be putting you to work for a while.
Part-timer' sounds like way too good of a treatment...
Ah, 'Servant' sounds perfect.
...What?

chat.t: If you go to the location I sent yesterday, you'll see a truck.
You are on your way, right?
You're not thinking of running away, are you?
Servant, there is no paradise for a runaway.
And if you run, you can say goodbye to your package forever.

o: I'm only showing up because this is so dirty and unfair.

chat.t: You'll have to work overtime for as long as you're late!
Hey, Servant. I just got back.
Why did you just leave without saying anything?
Report to me before you leave next time.
Also, I noticed quite a few spots you missed while cleaning the truck.
Sleep well, and text me when you see this tomorrow.

lines.t:
Unable to withstand Charlotte's threats,
I headed to the location she gave me yesterday.
She definitely said there would be a truck around here...

You're here, Servant?
Good morning.

Oh, hey.
By the way...
Why are you getting into a fight first thing in the morning?
Well, that happens from time to time when you run a business.

Simply put, dealing with troublesome customers.
Dealing with the kind of people I hate the most.
What on earth do they think a business contract based on mutual trust is?
Mutual trust? You're one to talk.
The same person who pulls cheap tricks with fine print?

What?!
I can't hear you over the gunshots!!

Hey, Charlotte!
Do you have any idea how much heartache you caused me?!Gym Uniform Girl A
Guilt-ridden because I couldn't protect it, I soaked my pillow with tears every single day...!Gym Uniform Girl A
Give it back! My X-Mile 1/2 scale Fit Flurry statue!!Gym Uniform Girl A

Me too!
Give me back my Lykee Zoom Boost running shoes!!Gym Uniform Girl B
You have quite the track record.
Excuse me? I always conduct business fairly.
They're just throwing a temper tantrum.

Anyway.
You came at the perfect time.

What are you doing?
Grab a weapon.
We need to drive out these trespassers.
That wasn't in the contract.

What?
Is this a joke to you? Grab something and get ready.
But I can cheer you on like a champ.
I will avenge my figure!Gym Uniform Girl A
Vengeance for my running shoes!Gym Uniform Girl B
...Haaah.
Inside the Lucky Truck
Gasp! Gasp... haa, haa... I'm exhausted...
Sigh, I'm not even good at fighting either.
How are you so completely useless?
What do you mean useless?
Do you know how hard I was cheering for you?
Does it make sense for the master to work, while the Servant only cheers?

...Ahem.
You never mentioned anything about fighting.

If something like this suddenly happens, you should lend a hand.
You're my Servant, after all.
...Well, whatever. Let's let that slide for now.
A bit late for introductions, but this is where you'll be working.
Normally, there's one more person besides you, but they're away on a combined vacation and business trip.

What on earth does a 'combined vacation and business trip' even mean?
Does it just mean they're slacking off?

And what's with this working environment?
You're a total sweatshop boss.

Watch your mouth.
I cherish my employees so much.
Anyway, your job is to fill in for that employee.
Don't worry, it's not that hard.
Just general chores like cooking and cleaning, plus a few things I tell you to do.
I'll be busy with external business meetings for a while, you see?
So don't think you can slack off just because there's no one supervising.
Any questions so far?
So, what should I do today?
Hmm, then start cleaning right away.
The outside of the truck got really dirty because of the attack earlier.
Wait, you want me to clean the outside of the truck, too?

Of course.
The inside is clean, isn't it?

Just make sure you do a thorough cleaning today.
Since we don't have much time.
Anyway, I'm heading out, so do a good job, okay?
No, wait...
Day 1 as a Servant.
I sucked it up and worked, keeping my mind on the Limited Edition Massage Device.

chat.t: Why didn't you reply to my message from yesterday?
And from now on, wait for me to get back.
Don't clock out until I check your work.

o: How am I supposed to just wait when I don't even know when you'll be back?

chat.t: I'll get back as fast as I can, so just wait!
Can't you just chill inside or something?
I said, do you get it?

o: God, this is so petty and miserable.

lines.t: (Even after that, I kept showing up to Charlotte's truck.)
Hey Servant, look at the state of this place.
Clean it again.
(But no matter how hard I worked, the only thing I got in return was workplace harassment.)
Hey Servant, there's still a stain on this outfit.
Wash it again.
(I couldn't just keep taking this.)
Hmm, hmm-hmm♪
I need to take a quick shower and rest—

Hey Servant!!
What do you think you're doing in here?!
Get out right now!!
*Sigh* That guy is unbelievable...
Huh? Did I forget to bring my underwear...?
(For better or worse, it's time to turn the tables.)
Hey Servant, I'll be late tomorrow.
But you'll have plenty of time, so make sure you do a good job.
I'm tired of nagging you every single day, you know?
(Tomorrow, I have no choice but to do *that*.)
Late the next night
*Sigh* I'm so tired...
...Hehe, but at least tomorrow's lunch is meat.
I'm sure he'll love it, right?
Puhahaha!
Hey, you... Wh-What are you... Huh...?
Yo, welcome back.
Servant... Wh-What are you doing...?
Wh-Why is this place such a mess...?

Huh? S-Say something...
Ah! D-Don't tell me those guys from before did this...?!
I'm on strike.
...W-What?
Since you don't seem to realize how hard I've been working.
I'm letting you realize the true value of a Servant.
S-So, just... just because of that, you... like this...
Doing absolutely nothing... leaving it in a complete mess...
Y-You were slacking off... just to make a point...?
Slacking off? No, this is a legitimate strike.
...*Sigh*
Fine, Servant.
You don't have to do anything anymore.
Huh? Seriously?
Yeah, I guess "Servant" was way too generous a title for you.
You can't even handle a simple task, and what? A strike?
I shouldn't have given you that much freedom in the first place.
You're not even a Servant anymore.
Yes, a simple "doormat" suits you much better.
Just a tool that waits quietly for its master's orders, then wipes their feet when they return.
Wh-What?
Don't make me repeat myself. It's a waste of breath.

What are you waiting for?
Come here and wipe my feet, doormat.

Ugh, so frustrating!
You don't understand how I feel at all...!
Get out right now, you pervert!!
Why are you like this? I only did what you told me to do.
I was just doing my best to be a good doormat.
Ugh... grrr...!
I never t-told you to do <bouten>that kind of thing</bouten>!!
That kind of thing? What's "that kind of thing"?
Ugh...
I, I mean!!
...Ughhhh!!
Whatever, just get out!!
So I don't have to come to work from tomorrow, right?

No way!
You still have to show up!!
What do you even want from me?

o: I showed up to work, but there's no one here.
Oh well, guess I have to take the day off today.

chat.t: There's a note on the table.
And what do you mean "take the day off"? You slacked off yesterday too!

lines.t: The day after becoming a doormat.
I showed up to work, but Charlotte was nowhere to be seen.
What, did she already leave?
Something was sitting on the table.
A handwritten note, and a box in very familiar packaging.
This is...
My Limited Edition Massage Device?
[To {player}.]
[You got your stuff, right?]
[The contract isn't up yet, but I'm making an exception and returning it early.]
[Oh, and I have some urgent business, so I'm heading out first.]
[There's nothing special to do today, so just do your usual chores.]
[And if you're too tired and want to rest, go ahead.]
[After you left yesterday, I cleaned up by myself and... it was actually pretty hard.]
[So if you're tired in the future, don't overdo it and just take a break.]
[Just don't go on any more stupid strikes.]
[Just make sure you let me know beforehand.]
[Because I am your master.]
...Hmm.
Maybe I should take a break.
Y-You're awake?
...Wait, did I fall asleep?
Seriously, sleeping so soundly in someone else's place.
Well, putting that aside...
It's super clean today...
Did you clean all of this by yourself?
I deliver when I put my mind to it.
Please, then why didn't you do it before...?
Well... anyway, good job today.
You can head home now.
Now that I think about it, you haven't changed yet either.
I-I was going to change... once you left.
Wh-What is it... Speak up if you have something to say...
You tired? Want me to wipe your feet?
W-What?!
N-No thanks...
Come on, I'm your doormat. Let me do it.
Urk...!
I said, I'm f-fine!
And, um, about calling you a doormat... I take it back.
Sorry, I was being way too harsh back then.
You can go back to being my Servant.
(Isn't that basically the same thing?)
My lady, would you like me to wipe your feet?

Seriously, stop it!
I said no!!
And so, after bickering with Charlotte for a bit, we parted ways.
I'm really not satisfied with ending things like this.
Whew... I have no choice but to do <bouten>that</bouten>.

chat.t: You did so well last time, so why are you acting up again??
Why did you just leave without cleaning or checking in again??
What on earth is the problem this time?!

o: I wasn't in the mood to clean yesterday.
And I'm not in the mood to go to work today.
Whatever, I have something to tell you, so meet me here tonight.

chat.t: What do you want to say?

o: Want me to give you another massage?

chat.t: I don't need it. I said I don't!

o: I really wanted to do it for you again...

chat.t: Well, if you really want to do it that badly...
I suppose I can grant your wish just this once.

lines.t: U-Ugh...
S-Servant?!
I-I'm here...
What is this place...?
It's just dark... and creepy...
Over here.
You scared the life out of me, you idiot!
Huh? What's this...?
Something... smells really nice.
Y-You...
Wh-What are you doing... why...
Wh-Why are you holding my hand...?
Let's go.
Hey, wait, where are you taking—

Y-You!
Wh-What are you plotting...?!

Welcome, my lady.
This is Lucky Massage Shop.
...Wh-What...?
Don't make me repeat myself. It's a waste of breath.
What are you waiting for? Come inside.

Wait—alright, I get it!
I'm going, so stop pushing!!
Unbelievable...
Haaah, haaah...
How's my massage?
Felt good, didn't it?
Kh...! Y-You... grrr...!
Well... I guess it was passable...
Ahem, not bad for a mere Servant.
I even used my Limited Edition Massage Device just for you.
Unbelievable...
You only worked because you wanted that back...
...Well, thanks anyway.
But instead of doing this, take better care of yourself.
That way you can work hard when you're on duty.
How is it that you only think about exploiting me?
I think about other things too, you know!
Like what?
Pffft...!
It's a secret.
